item.title: Java XPath Queries: Extracting Data from XML
item.description:
“Java XPath Queries: Extracting Data from XML”

When working with XML documents in Java, efficiently extracting specific pieces of information is a common task. XPath provides a powerful language for navigating and selecting nodes within an XML structure. This exploration delves into various Java implementations for querying XML using XPath, offering practical code examples and alternative approaches.
